findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners leased the space beneath Union Square to the Union Square Garage Corporation, whose bid it had accepted, to build and run a public garage there to plans by the architect Timothy L. Pflueger.

findings.description: Timothy Pflueger, architect for the Union Square Garage Corporation, presented revised plans for the surface and elevations of Union Square over the planned garage, and the Board of Park Commissioners approved them.
